sticky_left.description: Function to calculate sticky left positioning for columns in horizontal scrolling

function.description: Function signature: (columnIndex: number, columns: Array<ColumnDefinition>) => number

columnIndex.description: The zero-based index of the column to position

columns.description: Array of all visible column definitions in their current order

returns.description: number - The left offset in pixels for sticky positioning

examples: function(columnIndex, columns) { return columns.slice(0, columnIndex).reduce((sum, col) => sum + col.width, 0); }

set_column_controls_open.description: Function to open or close the column configuration dialog

function.description: Function signature: (isOpen: boolean, columnId?: string) => void

isOpen.description: True to open the dialog, false to close it

columnId.description: Optional column ID to focus on when opening the dialog

examples: function(isOpen, columnId) { setDialogState({ open: isOpen, focusColumn: columnId }); }
(isOpen, columnId) => dispatch({ type: 'TOGGLE_COLUMN_CONTROLS', payload: { isOpen, columnId } })

set_filter_controls_open.description: Function to open or close the filter configuration dialog

function.description: Function signature: (isOpen: boolean, filterContext?: object) => void

isOpen.description: True to open the filter dialog, false to close it

filterContext.description: Optional context object with filter presets or column focus

set_table_sort.description: Function to update table sorting configuration

sortConfig.description: Array of sort configurations to apply to the table

set_column_hidden_by_index.description: Function to show or hide columns by their display index

function.description: Function signature: (columnIndex: number, isHidden: boolean) => void

columnIndex.description: The zero-based index of the column in the current column order

isHidden.description: True to hide the column, false to show it

examples: function(columnIndex, isHidden) { const newColumns = [...visibleColumns]; newColumns[columnIndex].hidden = isHidden; setVisibleColumns(newColumns); }

set_filters_local_table_state.description: Function to update local filter state without triggering server requests

filters.description: Array of filter conditions to apply locally

set_selected_scatter_column.description: Function toggling a column occurrence as a scatter plot axis in table_state.scatter_plot_columns; selecting the current axis column clears it

function.description: Function signature: ({ axis: 'x' | 'y', column_id: string, column_index: number }) => void

set_selected_bar_chart_column.description: Function toggling a column occurrence as the bar chart column in table_state.bar_chart_column; selecting the current column clears it

function.description: Function signature: ({ column_id: string, column_index: number }) => void
